propositions: Plan-review Pass-1 finder was silently downgraded from opus to haiku after b690 landed, weakening the blocking-findings gate from frontier to trivial model class

Before b690, PydanticAIRunner.run discarded req.config so ladder rungs could not influence Pass-1; b690 made declarations reachable but plan-review.yaml still declares trivial instead of frontier, causing regression

Sidecar archaeology shows 115 opus runs before 2026-06-27, zero since; the downgrade coincides with _verifier_cfg landing and was unintentional—this is a regression restoration, not a new design choice
The prerequisite finder's bin packing now sizes to haiku's 200k window instead of opus's 1M, causing spurious context-limit escalation that burns tokens on the first attempt
Plan-review Pass-1 must run on frontier/opus while Pass-2 verify and Pass-4 coach run on standard/sonnet; the runner floor and batch config must not collapse onto one model

Model escalation via models_at_or_above bypasses model-class table entirely by hardcoding bare Anthropic IDs in sizing.MODEL_LADDER, allowing escalating criteria to silently jump to direct Anthropic on Bedrock-configured runs
